research.name: Liquid Glass Screens
research.note: Two React Native Expo welcome screens where a refracting Skia glass dome is swiped up into a small button that releases a plume of stickers.

effects: refracting glass dome on the bottom edge that becomes a small glass plus button after a swipe up
chromatic blue caustic ring gathering at the dome's crown mid-swipe
sticker plume rising out of the glass button, with stickers distorted through its lens
